request.name: data-request-headers
request.description: Headers of the request, as an object expression

indicators.name: data-ajax-icon
indicators.description: Selector of an element shown while the request is in progress

indicators.name: data-progress-bar
indicators.description: Selector of a <progress> for download progress

elements.name: e-json
elements.description: Fetches JSON from an endpoint and runs actions on response, usually mapToTemplate(). Disappears from the DOM after response (unless data-reusable).

attributes.name: data-src
attributes.description: GET endpoint to fetch JSON from (not needed with data-socket, data-event-source or data-cache-from)

attributes.name: data-response-name
attributes.description: Name of the response object in actions ({ body, statusCode, headers })

attributes.name: data-actions-on-response
attributes.description: Actions to run with the response

attributes.name: data-reusable
attributes.description: Keep element in DOM after response (needed for session cache and repeated trigger())

attributes.name: data-use-session-cache
attributes.description: Cache response in sessionStorage (needs data-reusable or data-only-update-session-cache-on-visibility-change)

attributes.name: data-only-update-session-cache-on-visibility-change
attributes.description: Refresh cached response only when tab becomes visible

attributes.name: data-do-not-run-on-activation
attributes.description: Don't fetch automatically, only on .trigger()

attributes.name: data-socket
attributes.description: WebSocket name to receive JSON from (instead of data-src)

attributes.name: data-event-source
attributes.description: EventSource name to receive JSON from

attributes.name: data-event
attributes.description: SSE event name; if absent, listens to plain message events

attributes.name: data-cache-from
attributes.description: Expression returning a cached response; if null, the request is made

elements.name: e-html
elements.description: Loads an html file and puts its content in place of the element.

attributes.name: data-src
attributes.description: Html file to load, like /html/parts/footer.html

elements.name: e-markdown
elements.description: Loads a markdown file and renders it as html (with code highlight and KaTeX).

attributes.name: data-src
attributes.description: Markdown file to load

attributes.name: data-internal-state
attributes.description: Object { markdown, extensions }; with markdown no request is made

elements.name: e-svg
elements.description: Loads an svg file inline, so it can be styled with CSS.

attributes.name: data-src
attributes.description: Svg file to load

elements.name: e-json-view
elements.description: Fetches JSON and shows it formatted, useful for debugging endpoints.

attributes.name: data-src
attributes.description: GET endpoint to fetch JSON from

elements.name: e-form
elements.description: Form that sends its fields as JSON. The button with data-request-url submits it and runs actions on response.

attributes.name: data-request-url
attributes.description: Endpoint to send the form to right after it appears (usually it's on the submit button instead)

attributes.name: data-request-method
attributes.description: Method of the request (POST by default)

attributes.name: data-response-name
attributes.description: Name of the response object in actions

attributes.name: data-actions-on-response
attributes.description: Actions to run with the response

attributes.name: data-do-not-trigger-on-enter
attributes.description: Don't submit when Enter is pressed in a field

attributes.name: data-socket
attributes.description: Send form as a message to this WebSocket instead

attributes.name: data-actions-on-progress
attributes.description: Actions run right before the request is sent

attributes.name: data-progress-bar
attributes.description: Selector of a <progress> for download progress

attributes.name: data-upload-progress-bar
attributes.description: Selector of a <progress> for upload progress

attributes.name: data-ajax-icon
attributes.description: Element shown while the request is in progress

attributes.name: data-button-ajax-text
attributes.description: Text of the button while the request is in progress

attributes.name: data-button-ajax-class
attributes.description: Class of the button while the request is in progress

attributes.name: data-download-response-body-as-file-with-name
attributes.description: Download response as a file with this name

attributes.name: data-validation-error-message
attributes.description: Default validation error message for fields

attributes.name: data-validation-error-class-for-element
attributes.description: Class added to fields with errors

attributes.name: data-validation-error-class-for-message-box
attributes.description: Class of error message boxes

elements.innerHTML:
<input type="text" name="name" placeholder="Name">
<button
  data-primary
  onclick="this.form.submit(this)"
  data-request-url="/"
  data-request-method="POST"
  data-response-name="response"
  data-actions-on-response="
    console.log(response)
  ">Submit</button>

elements.name: Submit button (e-form)
elements.description: Button that submits the closest e-form (onclick="this.form.submit(this)") to an endpoint and runs actions on response.

attributes.name: data-request-url
attributes.description: Endpoint to send the form to (not needed with data-socket)

attributes.name: data-request-method
attributes.description: Method of the request

attributes.name: data-response-name
attributes.description: Name of the response object in actions

attributes.name: data-actions-on-response
attributes.description: Actions to run with the response

attributes.name: data-actions-on-progress
attributes.description: Actions run right before the request is sent

attributes.name: data-button-ajax-text
attributes.description: Text of the button while the request is in progress

attributes.name: data-button-ajax-class
attributes.description: Class of the button while the request is in progress

attributes.name: data-upload-progress-bar
attributes.description: Selector of a <progress> for upload progress

attributes.name: data-download-response-body-as-file-with-name
attributes.description: Download response as a file with this name

attributes.name: data-socket
attributes.description: Send the form as a message to this WebSocket instead

elements.name: e-form-array
elements.description: Groups fields of an e-form into an array in the request body.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the array in the request body

elements.name: e-form-object
elements.description: Groups fields of an e-form into an object in the request body.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the object in the request body (not needed inside e-form-array)

elements.name: e-form-dynamic-value
elements.description: Adds a computed value to the request body of an e-form.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name in the request body

attributes.name: data-bound-to
attributes.description: Expression of the value

attributes.name: data-is-query-param
attributes.description: Send as a query param instead of body

elements.name: e-local-storage-value
elements.description: Adds a value from localStorage to the request body of an e-form.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name in the request body

attributes.name: data-key
attributes.description: Key in localStorage (supports ${…})

attributes.name: data-is-query-param
attributes.description: Send as a query param instead of body

elements.name: e-session-storage-value
elements.description: Adds a value from sessionStorage to the request body of an e-form.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name in the request body

attributes.name: data-key
attributes.description: Key in sessionStorage (supports ${…})

attributes.name: data-is-query-param
attributes.description: Send as a query param instead of body

elements.name: e-select
elements.description: Select that gets its selected option from data-value (can be an expression).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name in the request body

attributes.name: data-value
attributes.description: Value of the option to select (supports ${…})

elements.name: e-wrapper
elements.description: Loads a layout html file and places its content before, after, inside, or instead of the element matched by data-where-to-place.

attributes.name: data-src
attributes.description: Template file (created with "Add New Template")

attributes.name: data-where-to-place
attributes.description: Element in the template to place the content to

attributes.name: data-how-to-place
attributes.description: How to place the content ("instead" of the element by default)

elements.name: e-if
elements.description: Shows its content only if the condition is true.

attributes.name: data-condition-to-display
attributes.description: Condition expression

elements.innerHTML: Shown when the condition is true

elements.name: e-for-each
elements.description: Repeats its content for each item of a list.

attributes.name: data-list-to-iterate
attributes.description: List expression

attributes.name: data-item-name
attributes.description: Name of the current item

attributes.name: data-index-name
attributes.description: Name of the 1-based index variable (default index)

elements.name: e-reusable
elements.description: Template that stays in the DOM; each mapToTemplate() inserts its content again (before the template, or where the placement attributes say).

attributes.name: data-object-name
attributes.description: Name of the mapped object inside the template

attributes.name: data-release-on-load
attributes.description: Insert content right away (only the value "true" works)

attributes.name: data-append-to
attributes.description: Insert content at the end of this element

attributes.name: data-prepend-to
attributes.description: Insert content at the start of this element

attributes.name: data-insert-into
attributes.description: Replace content of this element

attributes.name: data-place-instead
attributes.description: Replace this element with the content

elements.name: template (data-object-name)
elements.description: Plain template released by mapToTemplate(selector, object) or releaseTemplate(selector). Inserted before the template unless a placement attribute is set; removed after release.

attributes.name: data-object-name
attributes.description: Name of the mapped object inside the template

attributes.name: data-release-on-load
attributes.description: Release right away (needs data-object-name; data-internal-state is the object)

attributes.name: data-internal-state
attributes.description: Object used on release on load

attributes.name: data-append-to
attributes.description: Insert content at the end of this element

attributes.name: data-prepend-to
attributes.description: Insert content at the start of this element

attributes.name: data-insert-into
attributes.description: Replace content of this element

attributes.name: data-place-instead
attributes.description: Replace this element with the content

elements.name: e-json-map
elements.description: Fetches JSON and maps it to its content right away, without actions.

attributes.name: data-object-name
attributes.description: Name of the response ({ body, statusCode, headers }) inside the template

attributes.name: data-src
attributes.description: GET endpoint to fetch JSON from

attributes.name: data-socket
attributes.description: WebSocket name to receive JSON from

attributes.name: data-prepend-to
attributes.description: Where to put the content instead of before the template

attributes.name: data-append-to
attributes.description: Where to put the content instead of before the template

attributes.name: data-insert-into
attributes.description: Where to put the content instead of before the template

attributes.name: data-place-instead
attributes.description: Where to put the content instead of before the template

elements.name: e-page-with-url
elements.description: Makes url params and queries (by pattern) available inside as urlParams. Put it at the start of <body>; everything using urlParams must be inside it.

attributes.name: data-url-pattern
attributes.description: Url pattern with {params}

elements.name: e-ws
elements.description: Opens a named WebSocket connection, used by e-json/e-form with data-socket.

attributes.name: data-src
attributes.description: WebSocket url

attributes.name: data-socket-name
attributes.description: Name of the connection

attributes.name: data-actions-on-open-connection
attributes.description: Actions when connection opens

attributes.name: data-actions-on-close-connection
attributes.description: Actions when connection closes

attributes.name: data-connection-icon
attributes.description: Element shown while connecting

elements.name: e-sse
elements.description: Opens a named EventSource (Server-Sent Events) connection, used by e-json with data-event-source.
